subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding and applying the Pythagorean theorem to find missing side lengths
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges physical squares built on each side of a right triangle to verify a²+b²=c²
